name: LOSLC Forms Self-Hosted
free_limit: GPL-3.0-licensed self-hosted form builder with form creation, public responses, role-based access, response analytics and exports. No upstream software-imposed form/submission quota or expiry documented; requires own Docker, PostgreSQL and compute.
watch_out: No free hosted service or infrastructure included. README quick-start uses placeholder clone URL and DEBUG=True with HTTP endpoints, so deployment instructions require correction and security hardening (DEBUG=False, HTTPS, secure database secrets) before production; no independent production deployment verified. GPL-3.0 redistribution/source obligations apply. Maintenance activity is limited (last upstream push in 2025).
